value.title: Phase 1: Contracts + fixtures
value.summary: Freeze the seams: trait, types, fixtures, contract suite.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Everything the fan-out depends on. When this phase closes, six coders can start in parallel with mechanical done-bars and never negotiate an interface.

value.title: Core types: IngestInput (PijId{id,folder} | NativeSession{session_id, harness, folder}), SourceCursor (per-store variants: byte-offset {path, inode, offset} / ledger seq / db rowid), RawRecord, and the normalized ConversationTurn payload type mirroring the measured spec (scratch/conversations-telemetry-sample.md).
value.success: Types compile in the placement the impl-guide names; no provider or store deps.
value.receipt: crates/core/src/conversation_source.rs @ a3bbfd2 — Harness, IngestInput, SessionKind, SessionFile, SourceCursor{ByteOffset,Seq,RowId}, RawRecord (TurnRole/TurnSource/TurnItem per prime ruling F), ReadBatch. No provider or store deps: fs3-core's allow-list row is unchanged and the_live_workspace_has_no_architecture_drift is green. 6 in-module tests; cargo test --all green.

value.title: Freeze the ConversationSource trait: resolve(&IngestInput) -> Vec<SessionFile>; read_incremental(&SessionFile, Option<SourceCursor>) -> (Vec<RawRecord>, SourceCursor). Doc comment carries the tenet-2 stop-and-ask rule: coders fill this contract, never widen it.
value.success: Trait merged with rustdoc stating the contract and the four planned impls.
value.receipt: crates/core/src/conversation_source.rs:290-324 @ a3bbfd2 — trait ConversationSource: Send + Sync with resolve() and read_incremental(); blocking and object-safe per prime ruling SA2. Rustdoc carries FROZEN, the fill-never-widen rule, the stop-and-ask, and the three-clause read contract. crates/core/src/ports.rs guard now reads 'A fourth port is stop-and-ask.'

value.title: Golden fixtures: sanitized real samples for all four stores (claude main jsonl + subagent sidecar + spilled tool-result; omp jsonl incl. xd:// writes and a compaction turn; pij events.ndjson incl. receipts; metrics-db rows in both dialects incl. a copilot session) harvested per the recipe (scratch/reconstruct/09-ingestion-recipe.md) into testkit fixture data.
value.success: Fixtures committed, personal content scrubbed, provenance noted per file.
value.receipt: crates/testkit/fixtures/conversations/{claude,omp,pij,metrics_db}/ @ a3bbfd2 — claude 2 sessions (148 + 35 records) incl. subagent sidecar, its .meta.json and a spilled tool-result; omp 193 records incl. a first-class compaction record at line 184, xd:// write toolCalls and a spilled bash log; pij 50 contiguous ledger records seq 118-167 incl. 2 receipts; metrics_db 100 event_kind=5 rows over 6 sessions, both dialects, with foreign-repo negatives. Per-set PROVENANCE.md records source, window, coverage, sanitisation counts and a rule-4 credential grep. Byte identity is pinned by fixture_sha256 in each expectations.json and asserted by testkit::the_committed_fixtures_are_exactly_what_the_expectations_describe.

value.title: Shared contract suite in testkit: one parameterized suite every ConversationSource impl must pass over its fixtures — resolve finds the files; read from None yields all records + a cursor; re-read from that cursor yields empty; appended fixture bytes yield only the delta; mid-line partial write yields no torn record.
value.success: Suite compiles against a fake impl; the delta and torn-record cases are mutation-checked.
value.receipt: crates/testkit/src/conversation_source.rs + tests/conversation_source_contract.rs @ a3bbfd2 — five cases (resolve, full read, free re-poll, delta-only append, no torn record) plus foreign-cursor refusal. MUTATION-CHECKED: the suite is proven RED against four fakes each wrong in one named way (IgnoresCursor, EmitsTornRecords, AcceptsForeignCursor, DuplicateOrdinals) and green once. 5/5 pass.

value.title: Pin reconvo.py as reference oracle: record its version/sha and the fixture->expected-output snapshots the Rust readers must reproduce (turn counts, kinds, dedup behaviour) as committed expectation files.
value.success: Expectation files exist per store fixture; divergence from oracle is a failing test, not an opinion.
value.receipt: assets/inputs/reconvo.py sha-pinned in assets/inputs/SHA256SUMS (62b89a89...); driver assets/inputs/tools/oracle_expectations.py imports it WITHOUT editing it, verifies that sha on every run, rebinds its three $HOME store roots at the fixture tree and bypasses its window/selector/truncation; expectations committed at crates/testkit/fixtures/conversations/*/expectations.json (claude 183 structural records, omp 193 + 87 oracle turns, pij 50 + 3, metrics_db 100 + 17); loader crates/testkit/src/expectations.rs + tests/conversation_expectations.rs, 10/10 green, each assertion proven RED (invented ordinal, reordering, duplicate, dropped oracle turn) and the green case reproduced from the fixture bytes rather than from the file itself. --check re-run is byte-identical. RULED: claude carries a structural claim only, labelled PM-derived-not-oracle (prime ruling, 2026-08-28) — the pinned oracle has no claude-native reader and its metrics-db mirror of that same session covers a disjoint window.
